question: Does the corpus need a record for the WeatherAPI.com listing on RapidAPI, a separate offer with its own plans and rate limits?
why: The RapidAPI listing named WeatherAPI.com shows a Basic plan at USD 0.00 a month with 250 requests a day as a hard limit and a rate limit of 1000 requests per hour, and a Mega plan at USD 0.00 a month with 500 requests a day and a rate limit of 10 requests per second; these are marketplace plans with a bandwidth fee, not the Free plan of weatherapi.com, so they do not give its burst limit.
